name: Void-Born Leech
journal_prompt: A giant, 6-foot leech of the Naraka rifts that attaches to larger monsters, draining their magical energy.
placement_note: Native to the Naraka rifts, not to delta water. It enters this realm through the Dwarka Gate (settlement_dwarka; see event_shadow_pact and event_naraka_portal), so it should be met near a gate and nowhere else. `underworld` is not renderable yet, so the export holds it as lore; when the Dwarka Gate exists as a landmark, add that biome.
